rule: Distinct registry identities must have distinct player-visible display names in en_us and in zh_cn, unless the pair is on an explicit allowlist with source and reason.

identity_grouping.block_item: block.{ns}.{path} and item.{ns}.{path} are one identity
identity_grouping.fluid_pair: fluid.{ns}.{path} and fluid_type.{ns}.{path} are one identity
identity_grouping.templates_are_separate: item.cruciblecraft.material_form.block is a template, not the aluminium block identity

not_a_fix: delete a key to hide a collision
give two identities one generic name
copy English into zh_cn so two rows look translated

asphalt_block_vs_slab.landing: slab names include Slab (and face when the face is a real identity)

andesite_meta.landing: Andesite Reinforced Bricks; never leak m8/m9 unless that meta is the formal player identity

bookshelf_family.landing: each identity uses its GT6 source-backed English name; same GT6 name may enter allowlist only with source citation

aluminium_block_vs_form_template.current: storage block '铝块' vs material_form.block template '%s 块' → '铝 块'
aluminium_block_vs_form_template.landing: Chinese concatenates without ASCII space; English keeps a space. Template and block identity remain different keys.

gates_after_landing.language_key_uniqueness: no two registry-backed keys differ only by slash vs dot
gates_after_landing.key_ownership: every live block/item/fluid in the expanded inventory owns its canonical key in en_us
gates_after_landing.zh_ownership: zh_cn either has real Chinese or omits the key; never English copy
gates_after_landing.datagen_stability: run datagen twice and diff src/generated/resources
gates_after_landing.slash_to_dot_regression: fail any registry-backed key whose path still contains '/'
